title: The Blindspot Is the Surprise Fuel
idiom: classical copperplate engraving with a torn, unengraved patch
hero_prompt: Classical copperplate engraving with a torn, unengraved patch, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink and print texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render: A classical copperplate engraving of a face rendered in fine crosshatched linework, one quarter of the portrait left as bare, unengraved white paper — a torn gap where the features simply aren't drawn. Muted sepia ink, Rembrandt-etching texture, the blank patch sits as the calm center of the image.
icon_prompt: A bold engraved-style icon: a solid black circle standing for a face, with one wedge cut clean out to bare white, high contrast, no linework, reading instantly as a shape with a piece missing.
